meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成网页测试、填表、截图与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or scraping

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以自动控制浏览器，比如打开网页、点击按钮、填写表单、截图、提取文字，还能录制操作视频。
howto.when: 当你需要让 Claude 帮你操作网页，比如填表、测试网站、截图或抓取数据时，它会接管浏览器。

say.text: 帮我打开 example.com，然后截图保存。
say.note: Claude 会打开网页并截图保存到文件。

say.text: 登录这个网站，填用户名和密码，然后提交。
say.note: Claude 会依次填写表单并点击提交按钮。

say.text: 录制我在这个页面点击按钮的过程。
say.note: Claude 会开始录制视频，记录后续操作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automate browser interactions: open web pages, click buttons, fill forms, take screenshots, extract text, and record videos of actions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need Claude to interact with a web page, such as filling forms, testing websites, taking screenshots, or extracting data.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will open the page and save a screenshot.

say_en.text: Log in to this site, fill in username and password, then submit.
say_en.note: Claude will fill the form and click submit.

say_en.text: Record my clicks on this page.
say_en.note: Claude will start recording a video of the actions.
